errors.text_span: до 2016 г., когато преминава малко над границата от 20 000
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line crosses the 20,000 mark in 2016. The chart shows that the line has already surpassed 20,000 by 2013, and is at a value of approximately 21,800 in 2016.
The description does not state the units for the Y-axis (EUR), which are specified in the figure caption. The generation prompt explicitly asks for the units of each axis to be described.
